S68_G1_MISSING_INPUT_FAIL_OPEN.consequence: A required shard/receipt/contract can be absent while G1 still reports every bound input digest matches.
required_fix: Every bound required path must fail G1 if absent.
Add a planted missing-file/path mutation test that fires G1 for absence, not merely digest corruption.
